people.name: Andrew Joseph Brinkman
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of ANDREW BRINKMAN HOLDINGS LLC)
people.title_or_status: ANDREW BRINKMAN HOLDINGS LLC MANAGING MEMBER
people.bio_note: Founder & CEO of Stableford Capital. 45+ year career spanning A.J. Brinkman & Co. (foreign exchange arbitrageur/institutional floor broker), Managing Partner of Petros Capital (a long/short institutional hedge fund -- corrected from an earlier 'COO/CFO' title per the firm's own description), CFO of Sequel Systems, Foreign Exchange Trader at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, and membership in the CME, NYFE, and CBOT; holds a B.A. from Cornell College. Roles at Baird and Merrill are noted on the firm's own materials but were not independently corroborated in Phase 4 verification.
people.bio_source: Independently corroborated via Andrew Brinkman's LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/andrew-brinkman-50539589, confirmed to exist via search but not directly fetchable) for the Petros Capital, CME/NYFE/CBOT, and Cornell College facts -- independent of the firm's own leadership page. Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): corrected his Petros Capital title from 'COO/CFO' to 'Managing Partner' per stablefordcapital.com's own description; the Baird and CME-trader-role claims could not be independently confirmed and are now flagged as firm-sourced only.

people.name: Justin C Thomas
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of OPR HOLDINGS LLC)
people.partner_quote: Justin Thomas — Managing Partner (firm website leadership page)
people.bio_note: Partner and Managing Partner at Stableford Capital. A CPA with 15+ years of experience as a portfolio manager/analyst, including 8 years at PartnerRe Asset Management as an equity analyst and portfolio manager, plus earlier roles at Citigroup (proprietary long-short equity), Montgomery Securities/Bank of America Securities research, and E-Stamp.
people.bio_source: Independently corroborated via LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/justin-thomas-cpa-68283050) and SmartAdvisorMatch (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/connecticut/justin-thomas-2819623), confirming the CPA credential and PartnerRe Asset Management tenure independent of the firm's own leadership page.

people.name: Mark Rehn
people.bio_note: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Compliance Officer at Stableford Capital. 35+ years in corporate finance and taxation, including a Tax Director role and Assistant General Counsel/Senior Tax Manager work; holds an LL.M. in Taxation and J.D. from DePaul University College of Law. Authored 'Making Gifts of Appreciated Stock – Time to Switch to Private Foundations?' published in the Journal of Taxation (January 1998), consistent with his tax-attorney background. A Crain's Chicago Business 'People on the Move' page under his name (chicagobusiness.com/people-on-the-move/mark-rehn) is indexed by search engines with the title 'Mark Rehn at Stableford Capital,' matching Crain's standard URL pattern for this feature — but the page itself returns a 404 on every direct access attempt (including Wayback Machine), so its actual content could not be read or confirmed. Treat the specific Crain's coverage as unconfirmed; do not cite it as a fact in outreach.
people.bio_source: SEC IAPD individual adviser record (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/2069136) and LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/mark-rehn-a844331/, based in Western Springs, IL, actively reshares Stableford Capital content) independently corroborate identity and Chicago-based tax-professional background. Journal of Taxation authorship (January 1998) independently confirmed via search. Crain's Chicago Business 'People on the Move' page exists per search-engine indexing but its content is unconfirmed — direct fetch and Wayback Machine access both failed.
